title: Load New Tipper Firmware via Tipper HMI (VISU) USB Install
summary: Update the tipper controller firmware using the Tipper HMI (VISU) USB install flow, then power-cycle the controller and confirm the HMI returns to the expected default screen state ("Visu_Default" with IP and subnet mask settings) and that F3 navigates to "Visu_MCP_Dual".
when_to_use: Use when you need to load new firmware onto a tipper controller using the HMI USB install flow and then verify the HMI returns to the expected default screen state.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the HMI button sequence, USB firmware install, and controller power-cycle; verify the HMI screen state after reboot.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access (physical access to the HMI on the tipper)
USB drive containing the new firmware version

access_required: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access (physical access to the HMI on the tipper)
system_preconditions: USB drive containing the new firmware version is available
USB dongle on the HMI is accessible

visual_references.description: HMI screenshot showing the "Visu_Default" screen with IP and subnet mask settings during tipper commissioning (used to verify expected default screen state).
Tipper commissioning step image showing the gray screen appearance after holding the top buttons during power-on (used to confirm firmware-load mode entry).
HMI screenshot showing the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen (used to confirm F3 navigation result).

steps.title: Turn off power to the tipper using the disconnect
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper controller is powered down before initiating the firmware-load button/power-on sequence.
steps.instruction: Turn off power to the tipper using the disconnect.
steps.expected_result: The tipper controller is powered off (HMI is not in normal operation).
steps.healthy_condition: Power is fully off prior to the next step’s power-on sequence.
steps.failure_condition: Power remains on (HMI does not behave as expected for a power-on sequence).

actions.label: Power off tipper via disconnect
actions.exact_action: Turn off power to the tipper using the disconnect.

steps.title: Hold the top three buttons on the tipper HMI
steps.purpose: Enter the firmware-load mode during the subsequent power-on.
steps.instruction: On the tipper HMI, press and hold the top three buttons.
steps.expected_result: The top three buttons are held continuously in preparation for powering on.
steps.healthy_condition: Buttons remain held through the power-on in the next step.
steps.failure_condition: You release the buttons before or during power-on.

actions.label: Hold top three buttons
actions.exact_action: On the tipper HMI, press and hold the top three buttons.

steps.title: Power on the tipper while continuing to hold the top three buttons
steps.purpose: Trigger the controller into the firmware-load mode.
steps.instruction: While continuing to hold the top three buttons, power on the tipper.
steps.expected_result: The controller begins booting into the firmware-load mode.
steps.healthy_condition: The gray screen appears in the next step while the buttons are still held.
steps.failure_condition: The gray screen does not appear (indicating the firmware-load mode was not entered).

actions.label: Power on tipper
actions.exact_action: While continuing to hold the top three buttons, power on the tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the gray screen does not appear after holding the top three buttons during power-on, stop and re-check that the correct buttons are held through power-on before proceeding.

steps.title: Wait for the gray screen
steps.purpose: Confirm the controller is in the firmware-load mode before starting the USB install.
steps.instruction: Keep holding the buttons until a gray screen appears.
steps.expected_result: A gray screen appears on the tipper HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: Gray screen is visible while buttons are still held.

actions.label: Confirm gray screen
actions.exact_action: Keep holding the buttons until a gray screen appears.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the gray screen does not appear, stop and re-check that the correct buttons are held through power-on before proceeding.

steps.title: Insert the USB drive into the HMI USB dongle
steps.purpose: Provide the firmware file to the controller for installation.
steps.instruction: Plug the USB drive containing the new firmware version into the USB dongle on the HMI.
steps.expected_result: The USB drive is physically connected to the HMI USB dongle.
steps.healthy_condition: USB is inserted and ready for the install action.
steps.failure_condition: USB is not inserted correctly (install option cannot proceed).

actions.label: Insert firmware USB
actions.exact_action: Plug the USB drive containing the new firmware version into the USB dongle on the HMI.

steps.title: Press INSTALL FROM FILE
steps.purpose: Start the firmware installation from the USB drive.
steps.expected_result: The HMI begins the firmware install flow from the USB.
steps.healthy_condition: The install flow proceeds to loading/progress or completion.
steps.failure_condition: The install flow does not start or does not progress.

steps.title: Load the firmware from the USB until the install completes
steps.instruction: Load the firmware from the USB (continue the on-screen install flow until it completes).
steps.expected_result: The on-screen install flow reaches completion.
steps.healthy_condition: Install/load progress completes successfully and the flow ends.
steps.failure_condition: Install does not complete or appears stuck/failed.

actions.label: Run install flow to completion
actions.exact_action: Load the firmware from the USB (continue the on-screen install flow until it completes).

steps.title: Power-cycle the controller and boot normally
steps.purpose: Ensure the new firmware is applied and the controller returns to normal operation.
steps.instruction: Power the controller off and back on, then allow it to boot normally without pressing any buttons.
steps.expected_result: Controller reboots normally without entering the firmware-load mode.
steps.healthy_condition: No button-hold sequence is active during boot.
steps.failure_condition: Controller re-enters firmware-load mode due to button presses during boot.

actions.label: Power-cycle controller
actions.exact_action: Power the controller off and back on, then allow it to boot normally without pressing any buttons.

steps.title: Verify Visu_Default screen appears with IP and subnet mask settings
steps.purpose: Confirm the controller is in the expected post-install default screen state.
steps.instruction: Verify the "Visu_Default" screen appears on the HMI displaying the IP and subnet mask settings.
steps.expected_result: The HMI shows the "Visu_Default" screen and displays IP and subnet mask fields.
steps.healthy_condition: "Visu_Default" is visible with IP and subnet mask settings shown.
steps.failure_condition: "Visu_Default" does not appear or IP/subnet mask fields are not shown after reboot.

actions.label: Check default screen state
actions.exact_action: Verify the "Visu_Default" screen appears on the HMI displaying the IP and subnet mask settings.

stop_or_escalate_if: If "Visu_Default" does not appear or IP/subnet mask fields are not shown after reboot, stop and escalate for support rather than continuing with further HMI navigation.

steps.title: Press F3 to navigate to Visu_MCP_Dual
steps.purpose: Confirm the HMI navigation works after firmware load and reboot.
steps.instruction: Press F3 to go to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
steps.expected_result: The HMI displays the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen after pressing F3.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing F3 does not navigate to "Visu_MCP_Dual".

actions.label: Navigate to Visu_MCP_Dual
actions.exact_action: Press F3 to go to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.

success_criteria: After the power cycle, the HMI shows the "Visu_Default" screen displaying IP and subnet mask settings.
Pressing F3 navigates to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
healthy_conditions: HMI displays "Visu_Default" with IP and subnet mask settings after reboot.
failure_conditions: Gray screen does not appear after holding the top three buttons during power-on.
"Visu_Default" does not appear or IP/subnet mask fields are not shown after reboot.
escalation_guidance: If "Visu_Default" does not appear or IP/subnet mask fields are not shown after reboot, stop and escalate for support rather than continuing with further HMI navigation.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.12 LOAD FIRMWARE steps include: power off via disconnect; hold top three buttons; power on while holding until gray screen; plug USB into USB dongle; press "INSTALL FROM FILE"; load firmware until completes; power off/on and boot normally without pressing buttons; verify "Visu_Default" with IP and subnet mask; press F3 to "Visu_MCP_Dual".

missing_details: Exact button labels/positions for the "top three buttons" are not provided in the packet text (only the instruction to hold the top three buttons).
The packet does not include the specific expected on-screen progress/completion indicators for the "INSTALL FROM FILE" flow (only that the on-screen install flow should complete).
